content: Evidence regarding the optimal frequency of blood glucose monitoring (BGM) for individuals with diabetes who are using only basal insulin or non-insulin injectable medications remains limited. While BGM, when combined with educational interventions, has demonstrated modest reductions in A1C levels, its effectiveness is significantly enhanced when incorporated into a structured self-management program. Specifically, structured BGM has been shown to improve outcomes by approximately 3% more than unstructured BGM practices.
